pddqol.title: Parents' quality of life questionnaire (Par-DD-QoL), 17 items

asp.notes: Seventeen items answered from 1 to 5 by a parent: 339 inclusion visits (337 of children, 2 of adults) and 48 follow-up visits, from 2021 to 2026, in centres A and B. Asked for children (form 352). 363 visits hold the seventeen items. Identified: the form 352 is titled PAR-DD-QOL (Parental-Developmental Disorder-Quality of Life questionnaire), seventeen radios from 1 to 5, a higher answer worse. The application has no script and the export no score; the items 1 to 16 hang together (Cronbach alpha 0.93 on the data). The published scale has an emotional and a daily-disturbance dimension and a global score (Baghdadli 2014, abstract); the items of each dimension, the 0-100 transformation and its direction were not settled by the literature check of 2026-11-21 (the paper is paywalled): the items are delivered as they are and no score is computed (O15 (3)). A section of the ASP cohort only. Years and centres (definition of done, D88; centres lettered as in D77, A the children's centre): two centres (A and B): four items (2, 5, 13 and 17) have a median one level higher in B than in A (means 0.2 to 0.6 higher, on a scale of 1 to 5) and item 12 is 0.3 lower; by year the medians of a few items move by one level (one visit in 2020). Levels of a whole-number scale, no other step.

pddqol.description: Parents' quality of life questionnaire (ASP): seventeen items answered from 1 to 5 by a parent of a child. The items are delivered as they are; no score is computed.
pddqol.reference: Baghdadli A, Pry R, Michelon C, Rattaz C. Impact of autism in adolescents on parental quality of life. Qual Life Res 2014;23:1859-68 (PMID 24504623)
flags: The published scale has an emotional and a daily-disturbance dimension and a global score from 0 to 100. Which items make each dimension, the 0-100 transformation and its direction are not settled ('to verify'): do not rebuild the published scores without the paper.
Filled for children in two centres, from 2021. The items 1 to 16 hang together (Cronbach alpha 0.93 on the data).

schooling.title: Schooling

asp.notes: The school history: ordinary schooling, repeated years, support at school and its kind, the highest class reached, and the time at school. 2134 inclusion visits (866 of children, 1268 of adults) and 266 follow-up visits, from 2011 to 2026. The labels and the lists of answers are those of the forms (191 inclusion, 243 follow-up) and of the thesaurus V2.13 (PROGRESS.md D14). The output names are descriptive English names since 2026-11-20 (the column names before); the raw column stays in `column`. A 9 is "not known". A support at school is reported for 420 of 2,018 inclusion visits with an answer; its kind (assistant, specialised class, SESSAD, IME, day hospital...) is asked after a yes. The highest class is free text (1904 visits, 586 different spellings): it is delivered as written. schooling_changed_fu is a box of the follow-up form. **Two forms (R31).** The time at school (three boxes) is on the inclusion form of 2019 only (with the full-time schooling, the time out of school and the help in class); the application writes 0 into its unticked boxes on every save, also on the 1,183 records of the other form, where it was never asked. The form of a visit is read from the questions that only the 2019 form asks (`version: schooling_form`, `filled`): 1,217 inclusion visits of the 2019 form, 1,183 other records (917 inclusion, 266 follow-up); the boxes of the time at school are read on the 2019 form only (3,549 zeros never asked become missing; no 1 is lost). The ordinary schooling question is commented out of the current inclusion form (191.php lines 24 and 118). The ULIS class (191.php line 62) and the schooling fields of the follow-up form (243.php: levels, primary, secondary, CAP/BEP, brevet, baccalauréat, higher studies) are not exported (request R167). On load the form hides and clears the schooling answers unless 'never went to school' is answered no (empty included; A96, eASPERGER.js lines 4364 to 4380): a re-save erases them. The years of education (EDULEVEL, two digits) are read as education_years_as_stored, `keep: false`, not delivered: their scale differs by centre (median 3 years in centre C with all of 102 values at 8 or below, 4 in centre B, 13.5 to 14 in centres D, E and H): a habit of the centres (O17 (4)), until the data managers answer (M90); 382 cells leave the delivery. The weeks out of school stop at 99 (20 of 92 values are 99: right-censored, delivered as typed); the hours of help in class at 99. A section of the ASP cohort only. Years and centres (definition of done, D88; centres lettered as in D77, A the children's centre): the support at school of children is 82% in centre C to 2015 (all the children of those years) and 43% to 46% in A and B from 2016 to 2020, then 26% from 2021 (adults 4% to 18% in the groups of 20 or more): the centre mix to 2015, then a fall within A and B with no known cause. The kinds follow: the inclusion class (CLIS or UPI) 60% in C to 2015, 10% to 21% to 2020 and 0% to 2% from 2021 (the ULIS class of the current form is not exported, R167); the day hospital 48% in C to 2015, 0% to 33% after. The change box of the follow-up form is yes on 64% of the visits of C (to 2015) and 11% to 16% in A and D. The box 'full time' of the time at school (2019 form) is 4% in H and 31% to 65% elsewhere. Documented here.

work.title: Work and living situation

asp.notes: The work contracts of the last 12 months, their length and kind, sick leaves, the situation without a contract and the kind of housing: 875 inclusion visits (369 of children, 506 of adults) and 64 follow-up visits, from 2020 to 2026 (forms 350 and 351, the same questions). The section belongs to the module 'Médico-éco' added in 2020 and 2021 (its first questions are on 48% of the inclusion visits of 2021 and 79% of those of 2024): an earlier visit is "not asked", not missing. The module has no visit-type or date condition (the application chooses the form by age alone), so the form can be filled on any visit, an earlier one included: 4 visits before 2020 hold it. The questions are on the last 12 months at inclusion and at follow-up alike: no _v0/_fu split. The labels and the lists of answers are those of the forms (350 adult, 351 child, 352 Par-DD-QoL, 353 parents) and of the thesaurus V2.13 (PROGRESS.md D14). The output names are descriptive English names since 2026-11-20 (the column names before); the raw column stays in `column`. The weeks under contract are asked after a yes to 'one or more work contracts in the last 12 months': the form hides and clears them after a no (eASPERGER.js lines 10062 to 10080), so they are 0 after a no (`asked_if`, 683 cells); 1 value under an empty contract question is kept (R2). The weeks of sick leave are 0 after a "no" (`asked_if`, 143 visits), as in BP, SZ and DR (BP D123). The 'no' of the sick leave is 2 on the adult form (350.php line 139) and 0 on the child form (351.php line 149); both read as no. The situation without a contract: 2 'retired' is on the adult form (350.php line 142), 8 'minor' on the child form; the thesaurus lacks the 2 and its lists of the kind of housing differ by form (R171). Full time is 1 and part time 2 on these forms. The weeks stop at 52 (blocking check). A section of the ASP cohort only. Not the DR job_months nor the BP, SZ and DR living arrangement: other questions. Years and centres (definition of done, D88; centres lettered as in D77, A the children's centre): a work contract in the last year is 1% in centre A (children) and 16% to 61% elsewhere: the age mix; the sick leave (23% in D to 56% in E) and the full time (48% to 69%) are habits or small groups (25 to 100 visits). Full time is 82% in 2022 (28 visits) and 42% to 60% after. No known cause, documented here.

common.note: A sick leave in the last twelve months and its length in weeks are in the four cohorts; a sick leave at the visit in BP, SZ and DR. Asked of the patients who work. After a no the weeks are 0 in the four cohorts. SZ and DR read the past year from the social form ("Arrêt de travail au cours de l'année passée"). BP reads it from the diagnosis form of the inclusion visit: the DSM-5 form asks the same question, but the DSM-IV form, where 3,327 of the 4,057 BP answers come from, has none, and an application script wrote the yes/no from the number of sick leaves (see the BP schema). When R74 ships, BP also takes the social form's answers where the diagnosis forms are empty. ASP asks another question: off work during the work contracts of the last 12 months, hospital weeks excluded.

panic_disorder_v0.label: Panic disorder, at inclusion
panic_disorder_v0.meaning: Panic disorder at inclusion (1 yes, 0 no). FACE BP: the box written by the export, set to missing where the agoraphobia box is ticked and no detail of the panic disorder is filled (206 inclusion visits, flag score_not_recomputed), because the export also ticks it for 'agoraphobia without panic disorder'. FACE SZ: a plain variable, the panic disorder with or without agoraphobia, asked after the screening question on panic attacks.

direction.source: range 0 to 1; schema notes (bp anxiety_v0): 'Yes/no answers are delivered as 1 and 0'; docs/bp/PROGRESS.md D150, D151

derivation.formula: Computed by the function facedata.custom.panic_unless_agoraphobia_only: panic disorder: the stored box, but missing where only agoraphobia can have ticked it (D151). Compared with the score stored in the column ceoccurtrouble_panique: a difference is flagged score_mismatch and this recomputed value is the one delivered.

birchwood_symptoms.label: Birchwood: awareness of symptoms (items 1 and 8, 0 to 4)
birchwood_symptoms.meaning: Awareness of symptoms, item 1 plus item 8 (0 to 4).

direction.source: label of birchwood_total: 'higher is better insight'; the total is the plain sum of the three sub-scores

derivation.formula: Sum of 2 values (birchwood01, birchwood08); all the values are needed; where no item is recorded the score typed in the form is delivered (flag score_as_stored). Compared with the score stored in the column birchw1: a difference is flagged score_mismatch and this recomputed value is the one delivered.

birchwood_illness.label: Birchwood: awareness of illness (item 7 and item 2 reversed, 0 to 4)
birchwood_illness.meaning: Awareness of illness, item 7 plus item 2 reversed (0 to 4).

direction.source: label of birchwood_total: 'higher is better insight'; the total is the plain sum of the three sub-scores

derivation.formula: Sum of 2 values (birchwood02, birchwood07); reversed first (minimum + maximum - answer): birchwood02; all the values are needed; where no item is recorded the score typed in the form is delivered (flag score_as_stored). Compared with the score stored in the column birchw2: a difference is flagged score_mismatch and this recomputed value is the one delivered.

birchwood_treatment.label: Birchwood: need for treatment (items 4 and 5, items 3 and 6 reversed, halved: 0 to 4)
birchwood_treatment.meaning: Need for treatment, items 4 and 5 plus items 3 and 6 reversed, halved (0 to 4).

direction.higher_means: better recognition of the need for treatment
direction.source: label of birchwood_total: 'higher is better insight'; the total is the plain sum of the three sub-scores

derivation.formula: Sum of 4 values (birchwood03, birchwood04, birchwood05, birchwood06); reversed first (minimum + maximum - answer): birchwood03, birchwood06; then multiplied by 0.5 and 0 added; all the values are needed; where no item is recorded the score typed in the form is delivered (flag score_as_stored). Compared with the score stored in the column birchw3: a difference is flagged score_mismatch and this recomputed value is the one delivered.

birchwood_total.label: Birchwood total (0 to 12, higher is better insight)
birchwood_total.meaning: Sum of the three sub-scores (0 to 12).

direction.source: label of the score: 'Birchwood total (0 to 12, higher is better insight)'

derivation.formula: Sum of 3 values (birchwood_symptoms, birchwood_illness, birchwood_treatment); all the values are needed; where no item is recorded the score typed in the form is delivered (flag score_as_stored). Compared with the score stored in the column birchw: a difference is flagged score_mismatch and this recomputed value is the one delivered.

sqol_sentimental_life.label: S-QoL sentimental life (items 14, 15; 0 to 100)
sqol_sentimental_life.meaning: Sentimental life, the mean of items 14 and 15 brought to 0 to 100.

direction.higher_means: better quality of life in sentimental life
direction.source: section 30: 'Each dimension and the index 0-100, higher = better QoL', Confirmed (direct: Boyer 2022)

derivation.formula: Mean of 2 values (sqol14, sqol15); then multiplied by 25 and -25 added; at least 1 of them are needed. Compared with the score stored in the column sqol19: a difference is flagged score_mismatch and this recomputed value is the one delivered.

direction.source: schema notes (sz sstics): '(13.1 - total) / 6.2, a decreasing straight line of the total; a negative z-score is more complaints than the reference group'

derivation.formula: Sum of 1 value (sstics_total); then multiplied by -0.16129032 and 2.11290323 added; all the values are needed. Compared with the score stored in the column ssticsz_wais4: a difference is flagged score_mismatch and this recomputed value is the one delivered.

derivation.formula: Sum of 25 values (wais3_pc01, wais3_pc02, wais3_pc03, ..., wais3_pc25); all the values are needed. Compared with the score stored in the column compltot_w: a difference is flagged score_mismatch and this recomputed value is the one delivered.

bfi_extraversion.label: BFI extraversion: mean of 8 items (1 to 5)
bfi_extraversion.meaning: Extraversion, the mean of 8 items (1 to 5), three of them reversed.

direction.source: schema notes (dr bfi): 'The published key reverses 17 statements, those that describe the opposite pole of their dimension'; items 1 strongly disagree to 5 strongly agree

derivation.formula: Mean of 8 values (bfi01, bfi06, bfi11, bfi16, bfi21, bfi26, bfi31, bfi36); reversed first (minimum + maximum - answer): bfi06, bfi21, bfi31; all the values are needed. Compared with the score stored in the column bfi_extr: a difference is flagged score_mismatch and this recomputed value is the one delivered.

derivation.formula: Mean of 10 values (bfi02, bfi07, bfi12, bfi17, bfi22, bfi27, bfi32, bfi37, bfi42, bfi45); reversed first (minimum + maximum - answer): bfi02, bfi12, bfi27, bfi37, bfi45; all the values are needed. derivation.formula: Mean of 9 values (bfi03, bfi08, bfi13, bfi18, bfi23, bfi28, bfi33, bfi38, bfi43); reversed first (minimum + maximum - answer): bfi08, bfi18, bfi23, bfi43; all the values are needed. direction.source: schema notes (dr rlri16): 'z = (free recall - mean) / SD, to two decimals; a higher z-score is a better recall, on every trial'

derivation.formula: Computed with the regression of norms/rlri16_free3_z.csv from rlri16_free3 and the age at the visit, with rlri16_sex (sex): a z-score, (raw - expected) / standard deviation, or the expected value when the table has no standard deviation; the table is read with the age typed in the form when it is within one year of the age at the visit. Compared with the score stored in the column mem12: a difference is flagged score_mismatch and this recomputed value is the one delivered.

ados3_classification.label: Module 3 classification

ados3_comparison_score.meaning: Comparison score (1 to 10), read by the form in a table of the manual from the total and the age; as stored, filled from 2017 (ADOS-2 only).

direction.higher_means: more severe on the 10-point severity metric
direction.source: scale_reference_aq_autism.md section 1: comparison score, a 10-point severity metric calibrated on percentiles of raw totals (confirmed in source, direct and abstracts)

ados3_social_affect.label: ADOS module 3, social affect (0 to 20)
ados3_social_affect.meaning: Social affect: sum of ten algorithm items (a code 3 counts 2, the codes 7 and 8 count 0), 0 to 20.

direction.higher_means: more autism-related behaviour observed in social affect
direction.source: schema notes (asp ados_module3): the total is social affect plus restricted and repetitive behaviour, autism from 9, autism spectrum 7 and 8, non-spectrum below

derivation.formula: Sum of 10 values (ados3_a07, ados3_a08, ados3_a09, ados3_b01, ados3_b02, ados3_b04, ados3_b07, ados3_b09, ados3_b10, ados3_b11); answers that count other points than their code: 3 counts 2, 7 counts 0, 8 counts 0, 9 counts 0; all the values are needed. Compared with the score stored in the column a23as: a difference is flagged score_mismatch and this recomputed value is the one delivered.

ados3_restricted_repetitive.label: ADOS module 3, restricted and repetitive behaviour (0 to 8)
ados3_restricted_repetitive.meaning: Restricted and repetitive behaviour: sum of four algorithm items, 0 to 8.

direction.source: schema notes (asp ados_module3): the total is social affect plus restricted and repetitive behaviour, autism from 9, autism spectrum 7 and 8, non-spectrum below

derivation.formula: Sum of 4 values (ados3_a04, ados3_d01, ados3_d02, ados3_d04); answers that count other points than their code: 3 counts 2, 7 counts 0, 8 counts 0, 9 counts 0; all the values are needed. ados3_total.label: ADOS module 3, total (0 to 28; autism from 9, spectrum from 7)
ados3_total.meaning: Total of the module 3: social affect plus restricted and repetitive behaviour, 0 to 28.

direction.source: schema notes (asp ados_module3): autism from 9, autism spectrum 7 and 8, non-spectrum below

cutoffs.meaning: autism (classification of the module)
autism spectrum (classification of the module)

ados4_classification.label: Module 4 classification
ados4_classification.meaning: Classification as stored: autism (communication 3, social interaction 6 and total 10), autism spectrum (2, 4 and 7) or non-spectrum.

ados4_communication.label: ADOS module 4, communication (0 to 8)
ados4_communication.meaning: Communication: sum of four algorithm items (a code 3 counts 2, the codes 7 and 8 count 0), 0 to 8.

direction.higher_means: more autism-related behaviour observed in communication
direction.source: schema notes (asp ados_module4): classification cut-offs, autism 3 and autism spectrum 2 on this score

cutoffs.meaning: autism (one of the three cut-offs of the classification)
autism spectrum (one of the three cut-offs of the classification)

derivation.formula: Sum of 4 values (ados4_a04, ados4_a08, ados4_a09, ados4_a10); answers that count other points than their code: 3 counts 2, 7 counts 0, 8 counts 0, 9 counts 0; all the values are needed.

ados4_social_interaction.label: ADOS module 4, reciprocal social interaction (0 to 14)
ados4_social_interaction.meaning: Reciprocal social interaction: sum of seven algorithm items, 0 to 14.

direction.source: schema notes (asp ados_module4): classification cut-offs, autism 6 and autism spectrum 4 on this score

cutoffs.meaning: autism (one of the three cut-offs of the classification)
autism spectrum (one of the three cut-offs of the classification)

ados4_total.label: ADOS module 4, communication and social interaction (0 to 22; autism from 10, spectrum from 7)
ados4_total.meaning: Total of the original algorithm: communication plus reciprocal social interaction, 0 to 22.

direction.source: schema notes (asp ados_module4): autism from 10, autism spectrum from 7

cutoffs.meaning: autism (one of the three cut-offs of the classification)
autism spectrum (one of the three cut-offs of the classification)

ados4_stereotyped_restricted.label: ADOS module 4, stereotyped behaviours and restricted interests (0 to 8)
ados4_stereotyped_restricted.meaning: Stereotyped behaviours and restricted interests: sum of four items (D1, D2, D4, D5) with the same recoding, 0 to 8. Outside the total; no cut-off.

direction.source: scale_reference_aq_autism.md section 1: the revised algorithm of the module 4 counts the items D1, D2 and D4 in a total with cut-offs (confirmed in source, direct, Hanawa 2025); schema notes (asp ados_module3): D1, D2 and D4 are in the total of the module 3. briefp_inhibit.label: BRIEF inhibit (10 to 30)

bvaq_verbalising.label: BVAQ verbalising (4 to 20, higher = more alexithymic)
bvaq_verbalising.meaning: Verbalising (difficulty putting emotions into words): sum of the items 1, 6, 11 and 16, with 6 and 11 reversed; 4 to 20.

direction.source: schema label (asp bvaq): 'BVAQ verbalising (4 to 20, higher = more alexithymic)'

derivation.formula: Sum of 4 values (bvaq01, bvaq06, bvaq11, bvaq16); reversed first (minimum + maximum - answer): bvaq06, bvaq11; all the values are needed; where no item is recorded the score typed in the form is delivered (flag score_as_stored). Compared with the score stored in the column bvaq21: a difference is flagged score_mismatch and this recomputed value is the one delivered.

bvaq_fantasising.label: BVAQ fantasising
bvaq_fantasising.meaning: Fantasising (reduced fantasy life): sum of the items 2, 7, 12 and 17, with 7 and 17 reversed; 4 to 20.

direction.source: schema labels (asp bvaq): the stored column is labelled 'factor 2: reduced fantasy life'; the factor is built like verbalising, labelled 'higher = more alexithymic'

derivation.formula: Sum of 4 values (bvaq02, bvaq07, bvaq12, bvaq17); reversed first (minimum + maximum - answer): bvaq07, bvaq17; all the values are needed; where no item is recorded the score typed in the form is delivered (flag score_as_stored). Compared with the score stored in the column bvaq22: a difference is flagged score_mismatch and this recomputed value is the one delivered.

bvaq_identifying.label: BVAQ identifying
bvaq_identifying.meaning: Identifying (difficulty identifying emotions): sum of the items 3, 8, 13 and 18, with 8 and 18 reversed; 4 to 20.

direction.source: schema labels (asp bvaq): the stored column is labelled 'factor 3: difficulty identifying emotions'; the factor is built like verbalising, labelled 'higher = more alexithymic'

derivation.formula: Sum of 4 values (bvaq03, bvaq08, bvaq13, bvaq18); reversed first (minimum + maximum - answer): bvaq08, bvaq18; all the values are needed; where no item is recorded the score typed in the form is delivered (flag score_as_stored). Compared with the score stored in the column bvaq23: a difference is flagged score_mismatch and this recomputed value is the one delivered.

bvaq_emotionalising.label: BVAQ emotionalising
bvaq_emotionalising.meaning: Emotionalising (low emotional reactivity): sum of the items 4, 9, 14 and 19, with 9 and 19 reversed; 4 to 20.

direction.source: schema labels (asp bvaq): the stored column is labelled 'factor 4: low emotional reactivity'; the factor is built like verbalising, labelled 'higher = more alexithymic'

derivation.formula: Sum of 4 values (bvaq04, bvaq09, bvaq14, bvaq19); reversed first (minimum + maximum - answer): bvaq09, bvaq19; all the values are needed; where no item is recorded the score typed in the form is delivered (flag score_as_stored). Compared with the score stored in the column bvaq24: a difference is flagged score_mismatch and this recomputed value is the one delivered.

bvaq_analysing.label: BVAQ analysing
bvaq_analysing.meaning: Analysing (externally oriented thinking): sum of the items 5, 10, 15 and 20, with 10 and 20 reversed; 4 to 20.

direction.source: schema labels (asp bvaq): the stored column is labelled 'factor 5: externally oriented thinking'; the factor is built like verbalising, labelled 'higher = more alexithymic'

derivation.formula: Sum of 4 values (bvaq05, bvaq10, bvaq15, bvaq20); reversed first (minimum + maximum - answer): bvaq10, bvaq20; all the values are needed; where no item is recorded the score typed in the form is delivered (flag score_as_stored). Compared with the score stored in the column bvaq25: a difference is flagged score_mismatch and this recomputed value is the one delivered.

bvaq_affective.label: BVAQ affective dimension (fantasising + emotionalising)
bvaq_affective.meaning: Affective component: fantasising plus emotionalising, 8 to 40.

direction.higher_means: more alexithymic on the affective component
direction.source: schema notes and labels (asp bvaq): sum of two factors, each counting a deficit

derivation.formula: Sum of 2 values (bvaq_fantasising, bvaq_emotionalising); all the values are needed; where no item is recorded the score typed in the form is delivered (flag score_as_stored). Compared with the score stored in the column bvaq26: a difference is flagged score_mismatch and this recomputed value is the one delivered.

bvaq_cognitive.label: BVAQ cognitive dimension (verbalising + identifying + analysing)
bvaq_cognitive.meaning: Cognitive component: verbalising plus identifying plus analysing, 12 to 60.

direction.higher_means: more alexithymic on the cognitive component
direction.source: schema notes and labels (asp bvaq): sum of three factors, verbalising among them ('higher = more alexithymic')

derivation.formula: Sum of 3 values (bvaq_verbalising, bvaq_identifying, bvaq_analysing); all the values are needed; where no item is recorded the score typed in the form is delivered (flag score_as_stored). Compared with the score stored in the column bvaq27: a difference is flagged score_mismatch and this recomputed value is the one delivered.

bvaq_total.label: BVAQ total (20 to 100)
bvaq_total.meaning: Total: affective plus cognitive component, 20 to 100.

direction.source: schema notes and labels (asp bvaq): sum of the five factors, verbalising among them ('higher = more alexithymic')

derivation.formula: Sum of 2 values (bvaq_affective, bvaq_cognitive); all the values are needed; where no item is recorded the score typed in the form is delivered (flag score_as_stored). Compared with the score stored in the column bvaq28: a difference is flagged score_mismatch and this recomputed value is the one delivered.

srsa_total.meaning: Total raw score: each answer counted from 0 to 3, fifteen items reversed; 0 to 195.

direction.higher_means: more difficulty in social responsiveness (more autistic traits)
direction.source: schema notes (asp srs_adult): the items that are not reversed are worded as problems; scale_reference_aq_autism.md section 3: the SRS is a measure of autistic traits that correlates about 0.7 with ADI-R algorithm scores (confirmed in source, abstract)

derivation.formula: Sum of 65 values (srsa01, srsa02, srsa03, ..., srsa65); reversed first (minimum + maximum - answer): srsa03, srsa07, srsa11, srsa12, srsa15, srsa17, srsa21, srsa22, srsa26, srsa32, srsa38, srsa40, srsa43, srsa45, srsa48; then multiplied by 1 and -65 added; all the values are needed. Compared with the score stored in the column srsa_score: a difference is flagged score_mismatch and this recomputed value is the one delivered.

srsr_awareness.label: SRS adult relative form, social awareness (0 to 24)
srsr_awareness.meaning: Social awareness: 8 items, each counted from 0 to 3 after reversal; 0 to 24.

direction.source: schema notes (asp srs_relative_adult): published key, answers 0 to 3 with the positively worded items reversed; scale_reference_aq_autism.md section 3 (measure of autistic traits, confirmed in source, abstract)

derivation.formula: Sum of 8 values (srsr02, srsr07, srsr25, srsr32, srsr45, srsr52, srsr54, srsr56); reversed first (minimum + maximum - answer): srsr07, srsr32, srsr45, srsr52; then multiplied by 1 and -8 added; all the values are needed.

srsr_cognition.label: SRS adult relative form, social cognition (0 to 36)
srsr_cognition.meaning: Social cognition: 12 items, each counted from 0 to 3 after reversal; 0 to 36.

direction.source: schema notes (asp srs_relative_adult): published key, answers 0 to 3 with the positively worded items reversed; scale_reference_aq_autism.md section 3 (measure of autistic traits, confirmed in source, abstract)

derivation.formula: Sum of 12 values (srsr05, srsr10, srsr15, srsr17, srsr30, srsr40, srsr42, srsr44, srsr48, srsr58, srsr59, srsr62); reversed first (minimum + maximum - answer): srsr15, srsr17, srsr40, srsr48; then multiplied by 1 and -12 added; all the values are needed.

srsr_communication.label: SRS adult relative form, social communication (0 to 66)
srsr_communication.meaning: Social communication: 22 items, each counted from 0 to 3 after reversal; 0 to 66.

direction.source: schema notes (asp srs_relative_adult): published key, answers 0 to 3 with the positively worded items reversed; scale_reference_aq_autism.md section 3 (measure of autistic traits, confirmed in source, abstract)

derivation.formula: Sum of 22 values (srsr12, srsr13, srsr16, ..., srsr61); reversed first (minimum + maximum - answer): srsr12, srsr21, srsr22, srsr26, srsr38, srsr55; then multiplied by 1 and -22 added; all the values are needed.

srsr_motivation.label: SRS adult relative form, social motivation (0 to 33)
srsr_motivation.meaning: Social motivation: 11 items, each counted from 0 to 3 after reversal; 0 to 33.

direction.source: schema notes (asp srs_relative_adult): published key, answers 0 to 3 with the positively worded items reversed; scale_reference_aq_autism.md section 3 (measure of autistic traits, confirmed in source, abstract)

derivation.formula: Sum of 11 values (srsr01, srsr03, srsr06, srsr09, srsr11, srsr23, srsr27, srsr34, srsr43, srsr64, srsr65); reversed first (minimum + maximum - answer): srsr03, srsr11, srsr43; then multiplied by 1 and -11 added; all the values are needed.

srsr_restricted_repetitive.label: SRS adult relative form, restricted interests and repetitive behaviour (0 to 36)
srsr_restricted_repetitive.meaning: Restricted interests and repetitive behaviour: 12 items, none reversed, each counted from 0 to 3; 0 to 36.

direction.higher_means: more restricted interests and repetitive behaviour
direction.source: schema notes (asp srs_relative_adult): published key, answers 0 to 3; scale_reference_aq_autism.md section 3 (measure of autistic traits, confirmed in source, abstract)

derivation.formula: Sum of 12 values (srsr04, srsr08, srsr14, srsr20, srsr24, srsr28, srsr29, srsr31, srsr39, srsr49, srsr50, srsr63); then multiplied by 1 and -12 added; all the values are needed.

srsr_sci.label: SRS adult relative form, social communication and interaction (four sub-scales) (0 to 159)
srsr_sci.meaning: Social communication and interaction: the 53 items of the four social sub-scales; 0 to 159.

direction.higher_means: more difficulty in social communication and interaction
direction.source: schema notes (asp srs_relative_adult): published key, answers 0 to 3 with the positively worded items reversed; scale_reference_aq_autism.md section 3 (measure of autistic traits, confirmed in source, abstract)

derivation.formula: Sum of 53 values (srsr01, srsr02, srsr03, ..., srsr65); reversed first (minimum + maximum - answer): srsr03, srsr07, srsr11, srsr12, srsr15, srsr17, srsr21, srsr22, srsr26, srsr32, srsr38, srsr40, srsr43, srsr45, srsr48, srsr52, srsr55; then multiplied by 1 and -53 added; all the values are needed.

srsc_awareness.label: SRS child form, social awareness (0 to 24)
srsc_awareness.meaning: Social awareness: 8 items, each counted from 0 to 3 after reversal; 0 to 24.

direction.source: schema notes (asp srs_relative_child): published key, answers 0 to 3 with the positively worded items reversed; scale_reference_aq_autism.md section 3 (measure of autistic traits, confirmed in source, abstract)

derivation.formula: Sum of 8 values (srsc02, srsc07, srsc25, srsc32, srsc45, srsc52, srsc54, srsc56); reversed first (minimum + maximum - answer): srsc07, srsc32, srsc45, srsc52; then multiplied by 1 and -8 added; all the values are needed.

srsc_cognition.label: SRS child form, social cognition (0 to 36)
srsc_cognition.meaning: Social cognition: 12 items, each counted from 0 to 3 after reversal; 0 to 36.

direction.source: schema notes (asp srs_relative_child): published key, answers 0 to 3 with the positively worded items reversed; scale_reference_aq_autism.md section 3 (measure of autistic traits, confirmed in source, abstract)

derivation.formula: Sum of 12 values (srsc05, srsc10, srsc15, srsc17, srsc30, srsc40, srsc42, srsc44, srsc48, srsc58, srsc59, srsc62); reversed first (minimum + maximum - answer): srsc15, srsc17, srsc40, srsc48; then multiplied by 1 and -12 added; all the values are needed.

srsc_communication.label: SRS child form, social communication (0 to 66)
srsc_communication.meaning: Social communication: 22 items, each counted from 0 to 3 after reversal; 0 to 66.

direction.source: schema notes (asp srs_relative_child): published key, answers 0 to 3 with the positively worded items reversed; scale_reference_aq_autism.md section 3 (measure of autistic traits, confirmed in source, abstract)

derivation.formula: Sum of 22 values (srsc12, srsc13, srsc16, ..., srsc61); reversed first (minimum + maximum - answer): srsc12, srsc21, srsc22, srsc26, srsc38, srsc55; then multiplied by 1 and -22 added; all the values are needed.

srsc_motivation.label: SRS child form, social motivation (0 to 33)
srsc_motivation.meaning: Social motivation: 11 items, each counted from 0 to 3 after reversal; 0 to 33.

direction.source: schema notes (asp srs_relative_child): published key, answers 0 to 3 with the positively worded items reversed; scale_reference_aq_autism.md section 3 (measure of autistic traits, confirmed in source, abstract)

derivation.formula: Sum of 11 values (srsc01, srsc03, srsc06, srsc09, srsc11, srsc23, srsc27, srsc34, srsc43, srsc64, srsc65); reversed first (minimum + maximum - answer): srsc03, srsc11, srsc43; then multiplied by 1 and -11 added; all the values are needed.

srsc_restricted_repetitive.label: SRS child form, restricted interests and repetitive behaviour (0 to 36)
srsc_restricted_repetitive.meaning: Restricted interests and repetitive behaviour: 12 items, none reversed, each counted from 0 to 3; 0 to 36.

direction.higher_means: more restricted interests and repetitive behaviour
direction.source: schema notes (asp srs_relative_child): published key, answers 0 to 3; scale_reference_aq_autism.md section 3 (measure of autistic traits, confirmed in source, abstract)

derivation.formula: Sum of 12 values (srsc04, srsc08, srsc14, srsc20, srsc24, srsc28, srsc29, srsc31, srsc39, srsc49, srsc50, srsc63); then multiplied by 1 and -12 added; all the values are needed.

srsc_sci.label: SRS child form, social communication and interaction (four sub-scales) (0 to 159)
srsc_sci.meaning: Social communication and interaction: the 53 items of the four social sub-scales; 0 to 159.

direction.higher_means: more difficulty in social communication and interaction
direction.source: schema notes (asp srs_relative_child): published key, answers 0 to 3 with the positively worded items reversed; scale_reference_aq_autism.md section 3 (measure of autistic traits, confirmed in source, abstract)

derivation.formula: Sum of 53 values (srsc01, srsc02, srsc03, ..., srsc65); reversed first (minimum + maximum - answer): srsc03, srsc07, srsc11, srsc12, srsc15, srsc17, srsc21, srsc22, srsc26, srsc32, srsc38, srsc40, srsc43, srsc45, srsc48, srsc52, srsc55; then multiplied by 1 and -53 added; all the values are needed.

srsc_total.label: SRS child form, total raw score (0 to 195)
srsc_total.meaning: Total raw score: the 65 items, each counted from 0 to 3, seventeen reversed; 0 to 195.

direction.higher_means: more difficulty in social responsiveness (more autistic traits)
direction.source: schema notes (asp srs_relative_child): published key, answers 0 to 3 with the positively worded items reversed; scale_reference_aq_autism.md section 3: the SRS correlates about 0.7 with ADI-R algorithm scores (confirmed in source, abstract)

derivation.formula: Sum of 65 values (srsc01, srsc02, srsc03, ..., srsc65); reversed first (minimum + maximum - answer): srsc03, srsc07, srsc11, srsc12, srsc15, srsc17, srsc21, srsc22, srsc26, srsc32, srsc38, srsc40, srsc43, srsc45, srsc48, srsc52, srsc55; then multiplied by 1 and -65 added; all the values are needed.

staic_trait.label: STAIC trait anxiety (20 to 60)
staic_trait.meaning: Trait anxiety: sum of the items 21 to 40, none reversed; 20 to 60.

derivation.formula: Sum of 20 values (staic21, staic22, staic23, ..., staic40); all the values are needed; where no item is recorded the score typed in the form is delivered (flag score_as_stored). Compared with the score stored in the column staic42: a difference is flagged score_mismatch and this recomputed value is the one delivered.

staic_state.label: STAIC state anxiety (20 to 60)
staic_state.meaning: State anxiety: sum of the items 1 to 20 with the ten negative adjectives (items 2, 4, 5, 7, 9, 11, 15, 16, 18 and 19) reversed; 20 to 60. Computed from the items; the stored total follows a wrong rule of the form.

derivation.formula: Sum of 20 values (staic01, staic02, staic03, ..., staic20); reversed first (minimum + maximum - answer): staic02, staic04, staic05, staic07, staic09, staic11, staic15, staic16, staic18, staic19; all the values are needed; where no item is recorded the score typed in the form is delivered (flag score_as_stored). Compared with the score stored in the column staic41: a difference is flagged score_mismatch and this recomputed value is the one delivered.

abc_irritability.label: ABC irritability
abc_irritability.meaning: Irritability: sum of 15 items answered from 0 to 3 (0 to 45).

derivation.formula: Sum of 15 values (abc02, abc04, abc08, ..., abc57); all the values are needed. Compared with the score stored in the column abc_irrit: a difference is flagged score_mismatch and this recomputed value is the one delivered.

abc_lethargy.label: ABC lethargy and social withdrawal
abc_lethargy.meaning: Lethargy and social withdrawal: sum of 16 items (0 to 48).

derivation.formula: Sum of 16 values (abc03, abc05, abc12, ..., abc58); all the values are needed. Compared with the score stored in the column abc_leth: a difference is flagged score_mismatch and this recomputed value is the one delivered.

Sum of 7 values (abc06, abc11, abc17, abc27, abc35, abc45, abc49); all the values are needed. Compared with the score stored in the column abc_stereo: a difference is flagged score_mismatch and this recomputed value is the one delivered.

Sum of 16 values (abc01, abc07, abc13, ..., abc56); all the values are needed. Compared with the score stored in the column abc_hyact: a difference is flagged score_mismatch and this recomputed value is the one delivered.

abc_inappropriate_speech.label: ABC inappropriate speech
abc_inappropriate_speech.meaning: Inappropriate speech: sum of 4 items (0 to 12).

derivation.formula: Sum of 4 values (abc09, abc22, abc33, abc46); all the values are needed. Compared with the score stored in the column abc_ispeech: a difference is flagged score_mismatch and this recomputed value is the one delivered.

cca_language_structure.label: CC-A language structure (0 to 63)
cca_language_structure.meaning: Language structure composite: sum of 21 items, 3 of them reversed (0 to 63).

derivation.formula: Sum of 21 values (cca01, cca02, cca04, ..., cca69); reversed first (minimum + maximum - answer): cca58, cca64, cca69; all the values are needed. Compared with the score stored in the column comm_ls: a difference is flagged score_mismatch and this recomputed value is the one delivered.

cca_pragmatic_skills.label: CC-A pragmatic skills (0 to 66)
cca_pragmatic_skills.meaning: Pragmatic skills composite: sum of 22 items, none reversed (0 to 66).

derivation.formula: Sum of 22 values (cca05, cca11, cca13, ..., cca50); all the values are needed. Compared with the score stored in the column comm_ps: a difference is flagged score_mismatch and this recomputed value is the one delivered.

cca_social_engagement.label: CC-A social engagement (0 to 81)
cca_social_engagement.meaning: Social engagement composite: sum of 27 items, 17 of them reversed (0 to 81).

derivation.formula: Sum of 27 values (cca03, cca07, cca08, ..., cca70); reversed first (minimum + maximum - answer): cca51, cca52, cca53, cca54, cca55, cca56, cca57, cca59, cca60, cca61, cca62, cca63, cca65, cca66, cca67, cca68, cca70; all the values are needed. Compared with the score stored in the column comm_se: a difference is flagged score_mismatch and this recomputed value is the one delivered.

ccc_speech.label: CCC-2 speech, raw score (0 to 21)
ccc_speech.meaning: Speech, raw score: sum of 7 items, two of them reversed (0 to 21).

derivation.formula: Sum of 7 values (ccc02, ccc24, ccc29, ccc38, ccc44, ccc51, ccc58); reversed first (minimum + maximum - answer): ccc51, ccc58; all the values are needed. Compared with the score stored in the column comm_speech: a difference is flagged score_mismatch and this recomputed value is the one delivered.

ccc_sidc.label: CCC-2 Social Interaction Deviance Composite: scaled scores of initiation, nonverbal communication, social relations and interests minus those of speech, syntax, semantics and coherence
ccc_sidc.meaning: Social Interaction Deviance Composite, computed from the stored scaled scores: those of inappropriate initiation, nonverbal communication, social relations and interests minus those of speech, syntax, semantics and coherence. A negative value means that the first four scales add up to lower scaled scores than the other four.

derivation.formula: Sum of 4 values (ccc_inappropriate_initiation_scaled, ccc_nonverbal_communication_scaled, ccc_social_relations_scaled, ccc_interests_scaled); minus ccc_speech_scaled, ccc_syntax_scaled, ccc_semantics_scaled, ccc_coherence_scaled; all the values are needed. Compared with the score stored in the column comm_sidcs: a difference is flagged score_mismatch and this recomputed value is the one delivered.
